parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a trashcan, made of plastic, typically rectangular and thin, covering the top opening of the container.
parts.Functional_description: The lid serves to cover the trashcan, preventing odors from escaping and keeping the contents concealed. It can be opened or closed manually or via a hinge mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: The lid rotates about a hinge axis, allowing it to open and close relative to the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the trashcan, made of plastic, rectangular in shape, and hollow to contain waste.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the trash bag and waste materials. It provides structural support for the lid and stability for the entire trashcan.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary during normal use, serving as the fixed part of the trashcan.
